achievements.title: First Fren
achievements.description: Sign in with Discord and start your pond history.

achievements.title: Pond Pioneer
achievements.description: Had Discord linked to PepecoinHub on the day the Fren Passport opened. It cannot be earned any more.

achievements.title: Fresh Fren
achievements.description: Create and save your first custom Fren avatar.

achievements.title: Welcome Back!
achievements.description: Come back to PondOS on the day after your first visit (UTC days).

achievements.title: Pepe Guesser
achievements.description: Make your first Pepe Guesser guess with a pin on the map.

achievements.title: Sharp Eye
achievements.description: Score a perfect 5000 in a daily Pepe Guesser hunt.

achievements.title: Week Scout
achievements.description: Guess in Pepe Guesser on 7 days in a row (UTC days).

achievements.title: Detective Fren
achievements.description: Score a perfect 5000 in Pepe Guesser on 5 different days. Unlocks the detective hat and the suit.

achievements.title: Scout Fren
achievements.description: Guess in Pepe Guesser on 14 days in a row (UTC days). Unlocks Lily's Explorer Pepe and the explorer hat.

achievements.title: First Words
achievements.description: Send your first message in the lobby chat (LAN Party).

achievements.title: Hey @Fren
achievements.description: Mention another fren in the lobby chat with @ and their nickname.

achievements.title: Community Fren
achievements.description: Chat in the lobby on 5 different days (UTC days).

achievements.title: Dear Editor
achievements.description: Send your first letter to the editor.

achievements.title: Junior Editor
achievements.description: Send 5 letters to the editor.

achievements.title: Senior Editor
achievements.description: Send 10 letters to the editor.

achievements.title: 14-Day Streak
achievements.description: Open PondOS signed in with Discord on 14 days in a row (UTC days).

achievements.title: Guess You Like It Here
achievements.description: Open PondOS signed in with Discord on 30 days in a row (UTC days).

achievements.title: Rookie Miner
achievements.description: Play Pepe Miner for 10 minutes with the cloud save on.

achievements.title: Miner Fren
achievements.description: Play Pepe Miner for one hour in total. Unlocks the hard hat.

achievements.title: NASA Is Hiring
achievements.description: Fly more than 5000 m in YEET THE PEP three times. Each flight counts once.

achievements.title: Moonwalker
achievements.description: Fly the full 6000 m in YEET THE PEP. A very rare stamp. Moon Rock is a separate future reward.

achievements.title: Certified Fren
achievements.description: Return to PondOS and complete at least one accepted signed-in interaction on 100 distinct UTC days (not necessarily consecutive). Server verified.

achievements.title: Curious Fren
achievements.description: Open five different PondOS apps. Server verified.

achievements.title: Adept
achievements.description: Reach at least 3000 m in YEET THE PEP. Unlocks the Sunset avatar background once server-verified achievements go live.

achievements.title: Gamer Fren
achievements.description: Play across the PondOS arcade. Server verified.

achievements.title: Game Night
achievements.description: Join a live LAN Party game night. Server verified.

achievements.title: Collector
achievements.description: Gather a shelf of PondOS collectibles. Server verified.

achievements.title: Old Frog
achievements.description: Reach a full year since joining the pond.

achievements.title: One Month Fren
achievements.description: Reach your first month in the pond.

achievements.title: First Hatch
achievements.description: Adopt your first PepeGochi.

achievements.title: Little Fren
achievements.description: Come back to your PepeGochi on a second day: it grows into a froglet.

achievements.title: One Small Step
achievements.description: Your PepeGochi grows up on its 7th care day. One small step for a man, one giant leap for a frog.

achievements.title: Good Parent
achievements.description: Provide care on 30 distinct days.

achievements.title: Perfect Parent
achievements.description: Complete a full month of good care.

achievements.title: Interior Designer
achievements.description: Place 10 decorations in your PepeGochi room.

achievements.title: Lunar Decorator
achievements.description: Decorate PepeGochi's room with moon-themed collectibles.

achievements.title: No Panic
achievements.description: Finish YEET without using any panic flaps.

achievements.title: Arcade Hopper
achievements.description: Try five different PondOS games.

achievements.title: Game Collector
achievements.description: Complete challenges in five PondOS games.

achievements.title: Secret Starter
achievements.description: Find your first PondOS secret.

achievements.title: Treasure Hunter
achievements.description: Discover ten different secrets.

achievements.title: The Secret Pond
achievements.description: Finish the six-part mystery hidden across the pond.

achievements.title: Frog Mail Reader
achievements.description: Find a mysterious message in Frog Mail.

achievements.title: Trophy Shelf
achievements.description: Display five different collectibles in your room.

achievements.title: 100 Days Together
achievements.description: Reach 100 days since your Discord Fren account was registered. Account age, not active days.

achievements.title: BALI
achievements.description: $0.01 - BALI. A mythic stamp for every fren when Pepecoin reaches $0.01 USD. Server verified; reserved until then.
